lede: The Telluride Town Council spends three hours Tuesday working through the 2027 budget — enterprise funds, open space, and affordable housing dollars all on the table, no votes yet but this is where the numbers get shaped. Ouray County commissioners are also moving real business Tuesday, including a Special Use Permit amendment and a vote on opting into Proposition 123's affordable housing commitment cycle. Norwood's Water Commission holds its Cossey Complaint hearing the same day, with two executive sessions and a contract vote in the mix. The Horror Show lands at the Palm Theatre this weekend, and a Ballot Measure 5A information meeting happens Monday for anyone trying to get straight on that one before it counts.

notable.stake: Water commission votes on contract and holds formal Cossey Complaint hearing.
Council shapes 2027 spending on housing and open space before formal adoption.
County votes on Prop 123 affordable housing opt-in and a Special Use Permit amendment.
Proposed ordinance would regulate psilocybin businesses in Ouray — public discussion open.
Public hearing on Horror Show alcohol permits for crowds up to 1,400.
